notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. R2-SA51-1A (450 x 750) illustrated (AA 300 x 500, B 600 x 1000, C 900 x 1500), 2015, 1:5; R50, white, no outer border. Composite sheet: the sheet dimensions only the assembly and names its parts as AS 1743 signs, so the parts are the national specs — the roundel (R2-6A(R) no right turn, elements copied from tools/specs/R/R2-6 mirrored for the (R) hand.json, its 440 ring at the sheet's 5 margin) and the times panel R9-1-1A (AS 1743 times of operation, one period, the national spec's layout scaled into the sheet's 438 x 288 box at x 6, y 456: border and edge as panels, letter heights and positions scaled). Vertical chain 5 / 440 (roundel) / 11 / 288 (panel) / 6 = 750; panel 6/438/6 across. The sheet's panel reads 7 - 9 00 AM MON-FRI (00 where the national R9-1-1 drawing shows 30) — drawn as the sheet. Times are the example; the R9-1-1 layout is the national one (its width figures not re-checked here).
